text_block_list.text:
One night. Just as Fenomeno's routine 
investigation report to Bubble Gum Fellow 
was drawing to a close—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Haha! So, does that conclude your 
investigation report? Feel better now?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Yes, perfectly! I have nothing 
left to worry about, sir!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You're not taking case notes 
today?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Teeth brushed—sparkling clean, complete! 
Windows, doors—locked, complete!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just this room? Usually, you even make 
sure the hallway is locked up tight. I 
knew it...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Well then, good ni—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno. Has the case not been solved 
yet?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Your usual routine is off, after all. —Is 
something from your private life still 
bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. I really can't hold a candle to 
Bubble-san, can I?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha! No need to hide it! If something's 
bothering you, just tell me anything.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Actually, I have recently begun 
looking after a certain junior, but—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
She seems somewhat hesitant around this 
officer. She will not openly share her 
racing concerns with me, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It is not as if I am disliked, however— 
conversation does not flow during 
stretches, and training together yields 
little response.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"How can I get her to open up on the 
track? I'm at my wit's end, sir...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm.
So the gap just won't close on the 
track, huh.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: What if you went outside the course, then?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Mmmgh?! Outside the course?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean, for example... eating a 
meal together and having a casual chat,
or 
something...?!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think so too! I mean, look at how 
we're talking right now.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...T-That's true!
Th-Thank you very much, 
Bubble-san! Thanks to you,
my worries have 
been resolved, sir!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I just made a small suggestion! 
You're the one who found the answer.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...No! This is all thanks to Bubble-san, 
sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I... if I do say so myself, am stubborn 
and tend to get my thoughts tangled up 
easily."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"At times like that, Bubble-san always 
lends a hand before I even have to ask
for 
help!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Though our forms may differ... to me,
this 
is the ideal figure of an ally of justice!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haha! Did you really have to go that far?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to strike back! Now it's 
my turn to list all the things I love 
about you, Fenomeno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Hold on, please give me a break 
here, sir!

Compared to the previous day, Fenomeno 
clocked a vastly superior time today.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely!
My worries are all cleared 
up, so I feel completely refreshed!
choice_data_list: You're in great shape, aren't you.

text_block_list.text:
"From what she said, it seems Bubble Gum 
Fellow helped solve her investigation and 
everyday troubles. She certainly has a 
wonderful roommate."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
All of this is thanks to Bubble-san... 
First, the plan is to share a table with 
my juniors in the cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
From maintaining discipline to taking
care of daily trivialities...
she's a wonderful 
roommate who rescues me from all my 
troubles!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let us forget our rivalries on the 
track and chat about our hobbies and
daily 
lives!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
First,
build a relationship of trust. Even 
if we hit a snag, report and consult 
Bubble-san again! I will resolve this no 
matter what!
